Base motion alone does not establish stepping or stable support. No hardware validity or formal acceptance claim.

interpretation.conclusion: PhysX training-distribution evidence also contains FL foot-bottom-above-thigh folding in body_high, step_00 and step_02, so the behavior is not solely a MuJoCo transfer artifact. PhysX body_low has no such FL folding, unlike the paired MuJoCo readout. PhysX step_01 falls at11.46s; the other five selected cases finish60s without recorded fall. These findings identify where folding occurs, not which reward term causes it.
